title: [3.3 beta1] Change settings orer in SMB section
symptom: In the SMB section of settings, when SMB is enabled, some settings appear/disappear, and the order is confusing. Specifically, UAM is always visible and appears in the middle, separating SMB-related settings. Users find it confusing that settings that show when enabling another are not just below it.
fix: A PR was made to address the main feedback and fix another issue, and a commit was referenced. The thread suggests reordering settings so that all SMB-related settings are next to each other, but no specific final fix is described in detail.
evidence_quote: I made a small PR to address main feedback and fix another issue. :) And for sure this could be further improved now that all settings are moved to kotlin.
